title: Grokipedia - the AI-generated, single-owner encyclopedia vs Wikipedia's open human model
source: Public record + reporting (The Hill, CNBC, NBC, Fox Business, Wikimedia, arXiv 2510.26899, Tow Center/Columbia Journalism Review), Oct 2025-Feb 2026. xAI launched Grokipedia (grokipedia.com) on Oct 27 2025, labeled v0.1 - an encyclopedia whose articles are written/curated by the Grok LLM rather than human volunteers; announced late Sep 2025 after Musk repeatedly attacked Wikipedia as ideologically biased ('woke'). The debut crashed within hours; the site logged ~885,279 articles at launch (vs 7M+ on English Wikipedia). CONTENT DEPENDENCY: many entries were adapted or copied directly from Wikipedia - some word-for-word - and some carried a 'content adapted from Wikipedia, licensed under CC-BY-SA 4.0' notice (e.g., the Nobel Prize in Physics entry); Musk said he wants Grok to stop using Wikipedia as a source by end of 2025. EDITORIAL MODEL: no human authors; articles 'fact-checked' by Grok; the public cannot edit, only suggest via a form. A Feb 2026 Tow Center/CJR analysis called the process 'centrally controlled' and reported AI-generated edits overtook human submissions (>75% of proposed changes) by Dec 2025. BIAS/ACCURACY: Musk positioned it as 'maximally truth-seeking' and neutral; early reporting found it slanted toward a Musk-friendly/right-leaning framing and omitting material unflattering to Musk (reporting cited the absence of his inauguration-gesture controversy and the xAI Memphis gas-turbine/air-quality issue). Wikimedia's response: 'Wikipedia's knowledge is - and always will be - human... even Grokipedia needs Wikipedia to exist.' HONESTY/GRADE: the launch, article counts, the Wikipedia-copying + CC-BY-SA notices, the no-human-authors/centrally-controlled editorial model, and the Wikimedia response are FACT; the 'slant/omission' findings are REPORTED analyses (graded reported/contested, with the specific examples attributed); whether an AI-driven, single-owner encyclopedia can 'escape bias' is the OPEN question - and the structural concern (one owner controlling a reference-knowledge layer) is labeled interpretation, not an assertion of intent to deceive. Note: Wikipedia and the Wikimedia Foundation are added as graph nodes here (Wikipedia was cited as a source across the corpus but was not itself a node). Overlay/structural edges only; the AI-financial SCC is unchanged. Cross-refs: spec-china-ai-stack-censorship (state-aligned reference control), spec-manufactured-division / the epistemic lens, spec-xai-colossus-power (the Memphis issue Grokipedia reportedly omits).

edges.notes: xAI launched Grokipedia (Oct 27 2025, v0.1) - a Grok-generated encyclopedia; crashed within hours, ~885,279 articles at launch. No human authors; articles 'fact-checked' by Grok; public can only suggest edits via a form. A Feb 2026 Tow Center/CJR analysis called it 'centrally controlled' with >75% of edits AI-generated by Dec 2025 (fact).

Musk announced and framed Grokipedia as a 'maximally truth-seeking' neutral alternative to a 'woke'/biased Wikipedia (which he faulted for citing NYT/NPR). Early reporting found the opposite - a Musk-friendly/right-leaning slant and omission of material unflattering to Musk (reporting cited the missing inauguration-gesture controversy and the xAI Memphis air-quality issue). FACT of Musk's framing; the slant/omission findings are REPORTED analyses, attributed; 'escapes bias' is the open question.

DEPENDENCY/IRONY: despite being pitched as a replacement, many Grokipedia entries were adapted or copied directly from Wikipedia - some word-for-word - carrying a CC-BY-SA 4.0 'adapted from Wikipedia' notice on some entries; Musk said he wants Grok to stop using Wikipedia by end of 2025. The AI 'alternative' is bootstrapped on the human-edited corpus it aims to replace (fact).

The Wikimedia Foundation operates Wikipedia's OPEN, human-edited, consensus model (7M+ English articles) and defended it: 'Wikipedia's knowledge is - and always will be - human... even Grokipedia needs Wikipedia to exist' - the human-vs-AI, open-vs-single-owner contrast at the center of the reference layer (fact).

STRUCTURAL concern (labeled interpretation): a single owner controlling a centrally-generated reference-knowledge layer - marketed as neutral but exhibiting owner-aligned slant/omission - is an information/epistemic-control vector, the mirror image of state-aligned reference control mapped in spec-china-ai-stack-censorship. No intent to deceive is asserted; the point is the concentration + the editorial opacity, not a verdict.
